text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This may be small comfort, but I know<n>that you
tried your best.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The opportunity to broaden my<n>knowledge of the
world has been<n>reward enough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And besides, these claw machines<n>seem more
difficult than I anticipated.<n>Many have surely
experienced the<n>same frustration.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame so few will get their<n>hands on these
plushies. I would love<n>to see them spread
throughout the<n>world...
